name: @factory/portal
description: MERN SaaS Factory Framework - Portal Orchestrator

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @factory/shared build && pnpm --filter @factory/backend build && pnpm --filter @factory/frontend build
scripts.cleanup: pnpm --filter @factory/backend run clean && pnpm --filter @factory/frontend run clean && rm -rf node_modules
scripts.fdeploy: echo '🚀 INICIANDO DEPLOY A PRODUCCIÓN...' && echo '🔧 Verificando builds...' && pnpm build && echo '🚀 Haciendo deploy desde raíz del monorepo...' && cd ../../ && flyctl deploy --config packages/portal/fly.toml --dockerfile Dockerfile
scripts.qa:check: pnpm qa:backend && pnpm --filter @factory/shared build && pnpm --filter @factory/frontend build
